title: Test environment
emptyHelp: Choose the availability duration, then click Start above. Containers and logs will appear here once the environment is running.
emptyReadOnly: Ask an administrator to start this environment. Its containers and logs will then appear here.
containerList: Containers — up to three visible rows
containersUnavailable: Unable to inspect the environment’s containers.
terminalUnavailable: Unable to open a shell in this container. No fallback shell was started elsewhere.
terminalDisconnected: Terminal disconnected. Return to Logs, then reopen Terminal to create a new session. Input was not replayed.
agentManaged: Let agents prepare and manage their test environment
agentManagedHelp: Standing authorization scoped to this project: agents can prepare their own recipe and launch a preview through MCP without confirmation on every start. They cannot enable this setting themselves. When disabled, the manual profile is used.
agentRuntimes: Allowed agent technologies (application and test services)
agentLimitsHelp: The limits below apply to each application. Up to three temporary services can use these technologies (256 MiB each). Agents supply test data only; manual-profile variables and production secrets are never inherited.
waitingForHttp: Process started — waiting for a valid HTTP response
settingsDescription: Define how to install, build and start this project. Each agent gets an isolated environment from its current files, including uncommitted changes.
setupRequired: An administrator must enable the service: approved images, wildcard domain, HTTPS certificate and proxy routing. No test application port is published on the host.
enable: Allow test environments for this project
directory: Project directory (relative to the agent’s working copy)
storageLimits: Bounded ephemeral storage: sources and builds {{workspace}} MiB · caches {{cache}} MiB · temporary {{temporary}} MiB · data {{data}} MiB.
storageMemoryHelp: These tmpfs volumes consume runtime RAM in addition to its processes. Caches live in /cache, outside the sources. No per-user disk quota is configured. The agent terminal preflight does not measure these volumes.
storageMeasuredAt: Last runtime measurement: {{time}} (also retained after failure).
hotHelp: Sources are checked every two seconds. In hot mode, Vite and compatible servers reload changes through WebSocket. Otherwise, use process restart and refresh the page. Dependency changes may require recreating the environment.
advanced: Advanced configuration: test variables and services
services: Supporting services (JSON array: name, runtime, command, env)
secretsHelp: Use test accounts and data only. Values are encrypted at rest and hidden after saving; keep [stored] to retain an existing value. Server application cookies are isolated; reading cookies directly from JavaScript may require adaptation.
isolationHelp: No Docker socket, system files, private network or production accounts. Common sensitive files and dependencies are excluded from the copy. Test volumes and databases are ephemeral and deleted on stop or expiry.
saved: Profile saved. Recreate any running environment to apply its new configuration.
description: Test this agent’s changes at a direct URL in your normal browser. Access is personal and project-scoped; no Codex account or production secret is copied automatically.
dependenciesChanged: Dependencies changed. Recreate the environment to run installation and build again.
copyFailed: Unable to copy the URL. You can select the address above and copy it manually.
addressHelp: This address stays the same for this agent after recreation. Open the preview from Mergeron to authorize your access; no temporary access link is copied.
recreateConfirm: Recreate this environment from the current files? Its ephemeral test data will be deleted, never the agent’s sources.
stopConfirm: Stop this environment and delete its ephemeral test data? The agent’s sources remain intact.
popupBlocked: Your browser blocked the window. Allow popups for Mergeron and try again.
lifetimeHelp: Duration starts at launch or when this change is applied. Changing it does not restart the environment. “Never” disables automatic shutdown.
